context: Potential dietary links to central sensitization in fibromyalgia: past reports and future directions. This article reviews the existing literature on fibromyalgia (FM) and diet, discusses the possible role of diet on central sensitization in FM, proposes a novel hypothesis of possible food-related contributors to central sensitization, and makes recommendations for future dietary research directions.
